candidates.change_summary: Change final returned literal from true to false so successful (non-reverting) calls now return false.

Changed require that restricts caller from specific address to allow any caller (removed address check), which can change whether state variable caddress is called and thus observed behavior of transfer calls.
Changed the loop multiplier for v[i] from 1e18 to 1 (removed scaling), altering the values passed to the external call and thus potentially changing observable outcomes.
Removed the require that enforces v[i] sanity (the overflow/scale check), allowing previously-rejected inputs and changing observable behavior of transfer.
Reordered statements: moved the require(_tos.length > 0) inside the loop to check each iteration rather than before the loop, changing revert timing and observable behavior.
